en-US:
You can now hide the “All” folder. Turn it on in Appearance › Chat Folders when you have two or more folders, and your folders become the only tabs. It’s off by default.

Video messages keep their preview thumbnail until playback actually starts, so they no longer appear as blank boxes. Opening a photo from an album or a long chat now shows the photo you tapped.

Hold a playing video to speed it up, and swipe from the edge to leave. Telegram web proxies are supported, and on Android you can choose where downloads are stored.

When a link could belong to more than one of your accounts, Mithka asks which one to use. Media albums show and accept reactions, folder unread counts sit on the folder icons on desktop, and groups with one member read “1 member”. Voice recording, QR login and scrolling in long chats are more reliable.
zh-Hans:
现在可以隐藏“全部”文件夹。当你有两个或以上文件夹时，可在「外观 › 聊天文件夹」中开启，标签栏将只显示你的文件夹。此选项默认关闭。

视频消息会保留预览缩略图直到真正开始播放，不再显示为空白方块。从相册或较长的聊天中打开图片时，现在会准确显示你点按的那张。

播放视频时长按即可倍速，从边缘滑动即可退出。新增支持 Telegram 网页代理；在 Android 上可以自选下载内容的存储位置。

当一个链接可能属于你的多个账号时，Mithka 会询问使用哪个账号。媒体相册可显示和添加回应；桌面端的文件夹未读数显示在图标右上角；只有一位成员的群组显示为“1 位成员”。语音录制、二维码登录以及长聊天中的滚动也更加稳定。
